title: Sections over a quasi-compact open of a directed colimit of sheaves with injective transition maps
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space (sheaves of sets on the site of open subsets of $X$ with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), $I$ a directed set (nonempty, every two elements have a common upper bound), and $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i}:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_{i'})_{i\le i'}$ a system of sheaves of sets on $X$ over $I$ ($\varphi_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{i''i'}\varphi_{i'i}=\varphi_{i''i}$) whose transition maps are injective on sections: $\varphi_{i'i,W}:\mathcal F_i(W)\to\mathcal F_{i'}(W)$ is injective for all $i\le i'$ and all opens $W\subseteq X$. Let $(\mathcal F,(c_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F)_i)$ be a colimit of the system in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then: (1) for every open $W\subseteq X$ and every $i$ the map $c_{i,W}:\mathcal F_i(W)\to\mathcal F(W)$ is injective; (2) if $U\subseteq X$ is a quasi-compact open, then every $t\in\mathcal F(U)$ is of the form $c_{i,U}(s)$ for some $i\in I$ and $s\in\mathcal F_i(U)$; that is, the canonical map $\varinjlim_i\mathcal F_i(U)\to\mathcal F(U)$ is bijective.

For a directed system of sheaves of sets with injective transition maps on a topological space, every section of the colimit sheaf over a quasi-compact open comes from a section of some member of the system
